newsitem.title: USA: Sheldahl blames Q2 loss on unit production.
newsitem.headline: Sheldahl blames Q2 loss on unit production.

text.p: Sheldahl Inc said Thursday lower-than-breakeven production at its Micro Products unit contributed to a loss in the second quarter.

The company reported a loss of $1.5 million, or $0.17 a share, in the period ended February 28 versus net income of $1.6 million, or $0.18 a share, a year ago. Sheldahl had an operating loss of $2.3 million in the period.
Sheldahl said the results were expected, adding it expects to see an increase in production shortly.
Sheldahl makes substrates, flexible printed circuitry and flexible laminates for sale to the automotive electronics and data communications markets.
Its shares were up 3/4 Thursday at 23.
